text: Brush semantics (lead, 2026-10-04): fixation i is the half-open interval [onset, onset+duration) and the brush is the half-open [from, to). A fixation is selected iff the two overlap (onset < to && from < onset+duration), so the bars the brush visibly touches are exactly the selection. Touching at an endpoint is not overlap, and a zero-length brush selects nothing. Stated as a named type. S4.5e stays a pure viz builder with test values; serving fixation timing from the backend belongs to the Explore integration (S6.x).
